results.raw_content: [Back to Search Programs](/search) # Master Intelligence Artificielle [Université Clermont Auvergne](/university/universite-clermont-auvergne) Clermont-Ferrand, France2 yearsTaught in FrenchOpen to international students ## About Master Intelligence Artificielle Tuition comes to 250 EUR per year. Université Clermont Auvergne, at its Aubiere campus in France, offers the Master Intelligence Artificielle, a two-year graduate program in artificial intelligence taught in French. Artificial intelligence is the field of computer science concerned with building systems that can perform tasks typically associated with human intelligence, such as recognizing patterns, making predictions, and processing language. Students in this field typically study machine learning and deep learning methods, algorithms and data structures, statistics and probability as applied to data analysis, and the design of systems for tasks such as image recognition, natural language processing, or decision support. Coursework often also addresses the practical implementation of models using programming and software engineering skills, as well as questions of ethics and reliability in automated systems. Graduates trained in artificial intelligence commonly work as data scientists, machine learning engineers, or software developers within technology companies, research organizations, or the growing number of businesses across sectors that rely on data-driven systems. Others move into research roles that push forward new methods in the field, or into applied roles within industries such as healthcare, finance, or manufacturing, where artificial intelligence techniques are used to analyze data and automate processes. Some graduates pursue further doctoral study, while others take on project management or consulting roles focused on the deployment of intelligent systems within organizations. The program runs for two years, beginning in September, with instruction delivered entirely in French. Yearly tuition is two hundred fifty euros, consistent with fees at French public universities.
